description1:
Welcome to the room environment.

In this virtual exhibition space, audio objects are located throughout the rooms. Move freely to experience spatial audio from different perspectives and identify the sounds in the exhibition objects.
description2:
Walk down the corridor and enter each side room to find the audio sources inside. Use the panel to identify a sound object.

Move by aiming at the floor and pressing the grab trigger.

Press Start, explore the rooms, identify the audio sources, and then press Finish to end the session.
